prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Our client suffered significant physical injuries and is currently receiving medical treatment, and we expect the full extent of those injuries to be documented in the coming weeks.

Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this matter to our office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you, your insured, or any representative acting on your behalf. Any inquiries received elsewhere should be referred to us without delay.

Please provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits, together with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any repair or inspection records. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any later proceeding.

We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this letter.
